Package gui

Class MainScreen_GUI

java.lang.Object
gui.MainScreen_GUI
public class MainScreen_GUI extends Object
Controller class for the Main Screen GUI. This class handles user interactions for employee, subscriber, and guest logins, as well as navigation to other screens such as the terminal and dashboards.
